introduction: sandbox/landlock is an AgentKit sandbox provider that needs no container engine, image or privilege: on a Linux host whose kernel offers Landlock ABI 4, it runs agentkit-sandboxd as a child process of the embedder in its own session, and the agent's Landlock ruleset (workspace, private HOME and TMPDIR, read-only system directories, TCP denied under NetworkNone) is the only boundary. It reports itself as a confinement, refuses every spec field it cannot honour before anything exists, fills a workspace from a public GitRepo through a second confined init agent, cleans up everything it started on Close, at the TTL and through Reap, and never confines the embedder's own process.

glossary.ABI 4 floor: The provider's minimum Landlock ABI (sandbox.LandlockTCPABI = 4, Linux 6.7), enforced both by the kernel probe in New and on the agent's Hello report after every attach, whatever Spec.RequireLandlock says.
glossary.GitRepo slot: Per-sandbox state allowing exactly one GitRepo Sync, before any other successful Sync and before the first Tools call; mirrors 17's slot rule with its own implementation.
glossary.destroy step: The provider's teardown, passed to attach as Config.Destroy and run once: (1) wait up to 5 s for the agent to exit, then SIGKILL its process group; (2) SIGKILL every non-zombie process whose session id is the agent's pid, rescanning for up to 5 s; (3) remove the sandbox directory without following symlinks, restoring owner rwx on each directory first.
glossary.effective spec: The Spec returned by sandbox.CheckSpec (TTL 0 replaced by 1h) with Workdir set to the host path <Root>/<id>/workspace for the agent's arguments.
glossary.init agent: A second agentkit-sandboxd started for a GitRepo Sync with --network unrestricted, the same workspace and extra roots, and a git-only environment. It runs git through its run_command tool beside the sandbox's own idle agent and is always closed before Sync returns.
glossary.marker: agentkit-sandbox.json (mode 0600) in the sandbox directory: the owner's pid, start time (/proc/<pid>/stat field 22) and boot id, the owner's role (creator or agent), the creation time, TTL, network mode and labels. It never holds Spec.Env.
glossary.owner: The process a marker names: first the creating process (role creator), then, after an atomic replace, the agent (role agent). It counts as alive only when /proc/<pid> exists, its start time equals the recorded one and the current boot id equals the recorded one.
glossary.probe seam: The unexported function New calls once to learn the kernel's Landlock ABI. Its default issues syscall.Syscall(444, 0, 0, 1), the Landlock version query; offline tests substitute a fake returning any ABI or errno.
glossary.process table seam: The unexported /proc reader the destroy step and Reap use to list processes, their session ids, states and start times; offline tests substitute a fake.
glossary.resolver directory: Under NetworkUnrestricted only: the directory of the file /etc/resolv.conf resolves to, when it lies beneath /run or /var/run and is not /run or /var/run itself (for example /run/systemd/resolve). It is passed to the agent as an extra --landlock-ro.
glossary.sandbox directory: <Root>/<id>/, mode 0700, where id is 16 random lowercase hex characters. It holds the marker agentkit-sandbox.json and the 0700 subdirectories workspace/, home/ and tmp/.
glossary.session kill: Action 2 of the destroy step. It reaches background jobs that tools.Run left in their own process groups, because they stay in the agent's session.
glossary.starter seam: The unexported function that starts an agent process and returns its net.Conn, exit status and stderr tail. Offline tests substitute an in-process agent.New served over pipes with a test-chosen Landlock report.

requirements.title: Package API, platform and kernel checks in New
requirements.rationale: An embedder deciding whether to fall back to podman needs one sentinel, returned from New, that means this host cannot confine a sandbox.

criteria.action: declare `Options{Root, AgentBinary string; ExtraRO, ExtraRW []string}`, the sentinel `ErrNoLandlock = errors.New("landlock: this host cannot confine a sandbox with Landlock ABI 4")` and `New(o Options) (sandbox.Provider, error)`, and build and vet on linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64
criteria.contract: New performs, in order and stopping at the first failure, the platform check, the kernel probe, the Root check, the ExtraRO/ExtraRW checks and the agent-binary resolution and version check; the version check is the only process New starts

criteria.condition: New is called on a GOOS other than linux
criteria.action: refuse without probing, creating a directory or starting a process
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error for which errors.Is(err, ErrNoLandlock) is true and whose message names the GOOS and `sandbox/podman`

criteria.condition: New runs on linux
criteria.action: query the kernel's Landlock ABI exactly once through the probe seam, whose default issues `syscall.Syscall(444, 0, 0, 1)` (landlock_create_ruleset(NULL, 0, LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION)), and issue no other Landlock syscall
criteria.contract: a probed ABI of 4 or more lets New continue to the Root check; the probe seam is invoked exactly one time per New call

criteria.condition: the probe reports a kernel Landlock ABI from 0 to 3
criteria.action: refuse the host
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error wrapping ErrNoLandlock whose message names the ABI found, `ABI 4`, `Linux 6.7` and `sandbox/podman`

criteria.condition: the probe itself fails with an errno
criteria.action: refuse the host and explain the errno
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error wrapping ErrNoLandlock whose message names the errno and, for ENOSYS, says the kernel has no Landlock; for EOPNOTSUPP, says Landlock is not enabled in `lsm=`; for EPERM, says the call is blocked, typically by a container's seccomp filter

criteria.action: be safe for concurrent use, so that concurrent Create calls on one provider each produce an independent sandbox with its own id, sandbox directory and agent process
criteria.contract: N concurrent Create calls that succeed return N sandboxes with N distinct IDs and N distinct sandbox directories; closing one leaves the others usable

requirements.title: Root, extra paths and agent binary in New
requirements.rationale: A misconfiguration must fail in New with a plain error, distinct from ErrNoLandlock, and must never let one sandbox reach another.

criteria.condition: New reaches the Root check
criteria.action: use `<os.UserCacheDir()>/agentkit-sandbox-landlock` when Options.Root is empty, make the path absolute, create it with mode 0700 when missing, and resolve symlinks in it once
criteria.contract: the provider's Root is an absolute, symlink-free path to an existing directory; a missing Root is created with mode 0700

criteria.condition: the resolved Root is not a directory, or cannot be created
criteria.action: refuse the options
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error naming Options.Root for which errors.Is(err, ErrNoLandlock) is false

criteria.condition: an ExtraRO or ExtraRW entry is a relative path or is `/`
criteria.action: refuse the options
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error naming `Options.ExtraRO[i]` or `Options.ExtraRW[i]` with the entry's index, for which errors.Is(err, ErrNoLandlock) is false

criteria.condition: an ExtraRO or ExtraRW entry, symlink-resolved where it exists and cleaned otherwise, equals Root, contains Root or lies beneath Root
criteria.action: refuse the options
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error naming `Options.ExtraRO[i]` or `Options.ExtraRW[i]` and Root, for which errors.Is(err, ErrNoLandlock) is false

criteria.condition: New reaches the agent-binary step
criteria.action: resolve the agent binary as Options.AgentBinary made absolute when set; otherwise `agentkit-sandboxd` beside the symlink-resolved os.Executable(), then exec.LookPath("agentkit-sandboxd") on the host's PATH; and accept only a regular file with an execute bit
criteria.contract: the first candidate in that order that is a regular executable file becomes the binary every agent and init agent is started from

criteria.condition: no candidate agent binary is a regular executable file
criteria.action: refuse the options
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error, not wrapping ErrNoLandlock, that lists every path tried and the install command `go install github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd@<buildver.Version()>`, or `cd sandbox && go install ./cmd/agentkit-sandboxd` when the version is `(devel)`

criteria.condition: an agent binary has been resolved
criteria.action: run `<binary> --version` once with a 10-second timeout and an empty environment, and parse its output as `agentkit-sandboxd <version> (protocol M.N)`
criteria.contract: New returns a non-nil provider and nil error when M equals sandbox.ProtocolMajor and N is at least 2

criteria.condition: the version run fails, times out, prints output that does not parse, or reports M different from sandbox.ProtocolMajor or N below 2
criteria.action: refuse the binary
criteria.contract: returns a nil provider and an error, not wrapping ErrNoLandlock, that quotes the version output and the install command of 18-REQ-2.6

requirements.title: Capabilities and Create refusals
requirements.rationale: The provider must say plainly that it is a confinement and refuse, before anything exists, every field it cannot honour.

criteria.action: return Provider "landlock", Isolation sandbox.IsolationConfinement, Network [NetworkNone, NetworkUnrestricted], every Resources capability false, Image false, Workdir false and Landlock true
criteria.contract: Capabilities() equals that value on every platform and for every Options

criteria.action: set Notes to text stating that the provider is a confinement, not an isolation, sharing the host kernel, memory, CPU and process table with no resource limits; that NetworkNone denies TCP only and leaves UDP and Multipath TCP unrestricted; that a process inside can connect to any Unix socket the embedder's user can reach (a D-Bus session bus, an ssh-agent, a podman or docker socket) and act outside the confinement through it; that it can signal the user's processes; that a process starting a new session can outlive Close; and that tool results name host paths
criteria.contract: Capabilities().Notes contains the substrings `not an isolation`, `UDP`, `Multipath TCP`, `Unix socket`, `D-Bus`, `ssh-agent`, `signal`, `new session` and `host paths`

criteria.condition: Create receives a Spec with any non-zero Resources field, Network.Mode NetworkAllowlist, a non-empty Image or a non-empty Workdir
criteria.action: refuse the spec through sandbox.CheckSpec(p.Capabilities(), spec) before creating any directory or starting any process
criteria.contract: returns a nil sandbox and a *sandbox.SpecError with Provider "landlock" and Field `Resources.<name>`, `Network.Mode`, `Image` or `Workdir`, matching sandbox.ErrUnsupported; Root has no new entry and no process was started

criteria.condition: Create receives a Spec whose Provider map has any key
criteria.action: refuse the spec before creating any directory or starting any process
criteria.contract: returns a nil sandbox and a *sandbox.SpecError{Provider: "landlock", Field: "Provider"} whose message names the first key in sorted order, matching sandbox.ErrUnsupported; Root has no new entry and no process was started

criteria.condition: Create receives a Spec whose Env sets HOME or TMPDIR
criteria.action: refuse the spec instead of overriding the variable, before creating any directory or starting any process
criteria.contract: returns a nil sandbox and a *sandbox.SpecError{Provider: "landlock", Field: "Env"} whose reason names the variable and says the provider sets it to the sandbox's private directory; Root has no new entry and no process was started

criteria.condition: Create receives a Spec that passes every check, including one with RequireLandlock true, TTL 0 or Labels set
criteria.action: accept it, use the effective spec's TTL of 1h when TTL is 0, and record Labels only in the marker
criteria.contract: the returned sandbox's Spec().TTL is 1h for a zero TTL; RequireLandlock does not cause a refusal on a host that passed New; Labels appear in the marker and in no agent argument or environment value

requirements.title: Sandbox directory and marker
requirements.rationale: Reap and cleanup depend on a private, well-formed directory whose marker names a process that can be told apart from a reused pid.

criteria.condition: Create has passed every spec check
criteria.action: draw 16 random lowercase hex characters as the id, create `<Root>/<id>/` with mode 0700, write the marker `agentkit-sandbox.json` with mode 0600 immediately, and then create `workspace/`, `home/` and `tmp/`, each chmodded to 0700 whatever the umask
criteria.contract: the sandbox's ID() matches ^[0-9a-f]{16}$; under umask 0, 022 and 077 the directory and its three subdirectories have mode 0700 and the marker has mode 0600

criteria.action: record the owner's pid, its start time from /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, the boot id from /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, the owner's role `creator` or `agent`, the creation time, the TTL, the network mode and the labels, and never record any Spec.Env name or value
criteria.contract: the marker is JSON that decodes into those fields; for a Spec.Env containing a unique sentinel value, the marker bytes do not contain that value

criteria.condition: the agent process has started
criteria.action: replace the marker, which until then names the creating process with role `creator`, by writing a temporary file in the sandbox directory and renaming it over the marker, so that it names the agent's pid and start time with role `agent`
criteria.contract: before the agent starts the marker's pid is os.Getpid() and role is `creator`; after Create returns the marker's pid is the agent's pid and role is `agent`; no temporary file remains in the sandbox directory

criteria.action: keep the marker and `<Root>/<id>/` itself out of the agent's ruleset by passing only `workspace/`, `home/`, `tmp/`, ExtraRO, ExtraRW and the resolver directory as roots
criteria.contract: no --workdir, --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw argument and no HOME or TMPDIR value equals or contains `<Root>/<id>` other than the three subdirectories; on Linux ABI 4, `cat` of the marker through proxy execute fails with a permission error

criteria.condition: any step of Create fails after `<Root>/<id>/` was created
criteria.action: remove the sandbox directory before returning
criteria.contract: returns a nil sandbox and a non-nil error, and `<Root>/<id>/` no longer exists when Create returns

requirements.title: Starting, attaching and checking the agent
requirements.rationale: Landlock is the only boundary, so the agent's arguments, environment and reported ruleset are all checked rather than trusted.

criteria.action: build, as a pure unexported function, the argument list: sandbox.AgentArgs of the effective spec with Workdir `<Root>/<id>/workspace` (giving --ttl, --network, --workdir), then `--landlock-ro P` for each ExtraRO in order, then `--landlock-ro <resolver directory>` when one applies, then `--landlock-rw P` for each ExtraRW in order
criteria.contract: for Options{ExtraRO: [a, b], ExtraRW: [c]} and NetworkNone the list is AgentArgs(eff) ++ [--landlock-ro a --landlock-ro b --landlock-rw c]

criteria.action: take the resolv.conf path to read as a parameter and return the directory of the file it resolves to only when that directory lies beneath /run or /var/run and is not /run or /var/run itself; the provider adds that directory only under NetworkUnrestricted
criteria.contract: a path resolving to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf yields /run/systemd/resolve; a regular /etc/resolv.conf, a target directly in /run, a dangling link and a missing file yield none; under NetworkNone no resolver --landlock-ro is ever added

criteria.action: build, as a pure unexported function, exactly Spec.Env plus `HOME=<dir>/home` and `TMPDIR=<dir>/tmp`, plus `PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin` when Spec.Env sets no PATH, as `NAME=value` strings sorted by name, taking nothing from the embedder's environment
criteria.contract: with the embedder's environment holding a sentinel variable, the result contains no entry for it; a Spec.Env PATH is kept unchanged; the slice is sorted

criteria.action: start the agent from the resolved binary with the workspace as its working directory, SysProcAttr Setsid true, stdin and stdout as pipes adapted with stdioconn.New, stderr drained into a tail buffer of the last 8 KiB, a lifetime independent of Create's context, and a goroutine that waits on it and records its exit status
criteria.contract: the started agent is its own session leader (session id equals its pid); cancelling Create's context after Create returns does not end the agent

criteria.condition: the agent has started
criteria.action: call attach.Dial(ctx, conn, attach.Config{ID: id, Spec: eff, Destroy: <destroy step>, Provider: "landlock"}) and, after Hello and whatever Spec.RequireLandlock says, check that Agent().Landlock has ABI >= sandbox.LandlockTCPABI, TCP true under NetworkNone, the resolved workspace/, home/ and tmp/ among Writable, and no other Writable or ReadOnly root equal to or containing Root
criteria.contract: when every check passes, Create returns the provider's wrapper sandbox whose Spec().Workdir is the host path `<Root>/<id>/workspace` and a nil error

criteria.condition: attach.Dial fails
criteria.action: classify the failure after attach has run the destroy step
criteria.contract: sandbox.ErrProtocol errors and attach's RequireLandlock *sandbox.SpecError are returned unchanged; when ctx is done the error wraps ctx.Err(); when the agent has exited the error reads `landlock: agentkit-sandboxd exited with status N: <stderr tail>`; in every case the sandbox directory is gone and the agent's session has no live process

criteria.condition: the agent's report has ABI below 4, or TCP false under NetworkNone, or lacks the resolved workspace/, home/ or tmp/ among Writable
criteria.action: close the sandbox, running the destroy step exactly once
criteria.contract: returns a nil sandbox and an error wrapping ErrNoLandlock that quotes the report's ABI, KernelABI, TCP and Note; the destroy step's invocation count is 1 and the sandbox directory is gone

criteria.condition: a Writable or ReadOnly root in the agent's report, other than the three sandbox subdirectories, equals or contains Root
criteria.action: close the sandbox, running the destroy step exactly once
criteria.contract: returns a nil sandbox and an error naming Options.Root and the containing root and telling the caller to choose a Root outside the system directories; the destroy step's invocation count is 1

requirements.title: Confinement on a Landlock ABI 4 kernel
requirements.rationale: The provider is only worth using if the agent's ruleset actually keeps the model's commands away from the embedder's files and, under NetworkNone, from TCP.

criteria.condition: a sandbox created on a Linux host with Landlock ABI 4 or later is open
criteria.action: let proxy execute create files beneath the workspace, the sandbox's home/ and tmp/
criteria.contract: `touch` of a new file in the workspace exits 0 and the file exists on the host beneath `<Root>/<id>/workspace`

criteria.condition: a command run by proxy execute creates a file in the embedder's real home directory or reads a file in a sibling directory outside the ruleset
criteria.action: deny the access
criteria.contract: the command exits non-zero with output naming a permission error, no file is created in the real home directory, and the sibling file's content does not appear in the output

criteria.condition: a command run by proxy execute in a NetworkNone sandbox opens a TCP connection to a loopback listener
criteria.action: deny the connection
criteria.contract: the connect fails inside the sandbox and the listener accepts no connection

criteria.condition: a command run by proxy execute in a NetworkUnrestricted sandbox opens a TCP connection to a loopback listener
criteria.action: allow the connection
criteria.contract: the connect succeeds and the listener accepts exactly one connection

criteria.action: expose through Agent().Landlock the agent's applied ruleset
criteria.contract: on an ABI 4 kernel, Agent().Landlock.ABI == 4, TCP is true under NetworkNone, and the symlink-resolved workspace/, home/ and tmp/ are each among Writable

criteria.action: give tools exactly the environment of 18-REQ-5.3
criteria.contract: `env` through proxy execute prints exactly the Spec.Env entries plus HOME, TMPDIR and PATH, with HOME equal to `<Root>/<id>/home` and TMPDIR equal to `<Root>/<id>/tmp`

criteria.condition: the `go` on the sandbox's PATH lies beneath a system directory or beneath a directory named in Options.ExtraRO
criteria.action: let proxy execute run `go version`
criteria.contract: `go version` exits 0 and prints a line starting with `go version`

criteria.condition: the `go` on the sandbox's PATH lies only beneath a directory outside the ruleset
criteria.action: deny its execution
criteria.contract: `go version` through proxy execute fails with a permission error

requirements.title: Destroy step, Close and TTL
requirements.rationale: tools.Run gives every command its own process group, so only a session-wide kill and a permission-restoring removal leave nothing behind.

criteria.action: run exactly once per sandbox, on Close, at the host-side TTL and on every Create failure after the agent has started, performing stop-agent, session kill and directory removal in that order, running each action even when an earlier one failed, and finishing within attach's 30-second destroy budget
criteria.contract: returns errors.Join of the actions' errors (nil when all succeed); a second Close returns without running it again

criteria.condition: the destroy step stops the agent
criteria.action: wait up to 5 seconds for the agent to exit after attach closed its connection, then SIGKILL the agent's process group
criteria.contract: an agent that exits on EOF is reaped without a signal; an agent that ignores EOF is killed after 5 s and its exit is recorded

criteria.condition: the destroy step kills the session
criteria.action: scan the process table seam for processes whose /proc/<pid>/stat field 6 (session id) equals the agent's pid, skip zombies (field 3 `Z`), SIGKILL each, and repeat until a scan finds none or 5 seconds have passed
criteria.contract: after the action no non-zombie process with that session id remains, or the step returns an error naming the survivors after 5 s

criteria.condition: the destroy step removes the sandbox directory
criteria.action: remove the tree without following any symlink, restoring owner read, write and execute on each directory before removing its entries, and treat a missing directory as success
criteria.contract: a tree holding read-only directories (a Go module cache under home/, a `chmod -R a-w` tree) is removed completely; removal of an already-missing directory returns nil

criteria.action: for any directory tree mixing read-only directories, read-only files and symlinks to paths outside the tree, delete the whole tree and leave every symlink target, its contents and its mode unchanged

criteria.condition: Close is called on a Linux ABI 4 sandbox in which proxy execute started a background `sleep` with redirected output and ran `chmod -R a-w` on a directory tree
criteria.action: run the destroy step
criteria.contract: Close returns nil; afterwards the agent and the `sleep` process no longer exist and `<Root>/<id>/` does not exist

criteria.condition: a sandbox's TTL elapses without Close
criteria.action: let attach's host timer run the destroy step, while the agent's own --ttl ends the agent even when the host is gone
criteria.contract: a sandbox created with TTL 5s and never closed has no live agent, no live session process and no sandbox directory within a few seconds after its TTL; later calls on it fail with sandbox.ErrUnavailable

criteria.condition: the embedder's process dies while a sandbox is open
criteria.action: exit when its stdin closes, leaving the sandbox directory and any process that outlived it for Reap
criteria.contract: the agent process exits; the sandbox directory still exists with a marker naming the agent

requirements.title: Sync, Tools and the GitRepo init agent
requirements.rationale: A GitRepo clone needs TCP, which the sandbox's own agent must never get, so it runs in a second confined agent beside the idle one, under 17's slot rule.

criteria.action: forward ID, Spec, Agent, Export and Close to attach's sandbox, forward Tools and every non-GitRepo Sync under a read lock, and run a GitRepo Sync under the write lock, so Tools and Sync wait for an in-flight GitRepo
criteria.contract: a Tools or LocalDir Sync call issued during a GitRepo Sync returns only after the GitRepo Sync has returned

criteria.action: become taken on a successful GitRepo Sync, on any other successful Sync, and on the first Tools call whatever its outcome, and stay free after a failed GitRepo Sync
criteria.contract: after a failed GitRepo Sync a second GitRepo Sync is accepted; after any of the taking events a GitRepo Sync is refused

criteria.condition: a GitRepo Sync arrives while attach.Live fails, gitclone.Check refuses the repository, the slot is taken, or Agent().Git is false (checked in that order under the write lock)
criteria.action: refuse it before starting any process
criteria.contract: returns attach.Live's error, gitclone.Check's error, `landlock: GitRepo must be the first Sync and come before Tools`, or `landlock: git is not on the sandbox's PATH (<PATH>); a GitRepo needs it` respectively; no init agent is started and the workspace is unchanged

criteria.condition: a GitRepo Sync passes its preconditions
criteria.action: start an init agent from the same binary in its own session with --ttl the time left to the sandbox's expiry rounded up to a second, --network unrestricted, --workdir the same workspace, the same --landlock-ro and --landlock-rw flags plus the resolver directory, and an environment of exactly GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, the sandbox's HOME and TMPDIR and the sandbox agent's PATH; attach it with Spec{Network: NetworkUnrestricted, TTL: <that>}, Provider "landlock" and a destroy step of actions 1 and 2 only
criteria.contract: the init agent's argv and environment equal those values (no Spec.Env entry appears); its destroy step never removes the sandbox directory

criteria.condition: the init agent's report shows ABI >= 4 and the workspace among Writable
criteria.action: call Tools(ctx, sandbox.ToolOptions{DisableSpill: true}) on the init sandbox, call its run_command proxy with argv `git` followed by gitclone.Args(repo, <workspace>) under the Sync context bounded by the sandbox's expiry through the init-command seam, and always close the init sandbox before returning
criteria.contract: on success the slot is taken, Sync returns a zero SyncResult and nil error, the repository's files are in the workspace, no init agent process remains, and a TCP connect from the sandbox's own proxy execute still fails under NetworkNone

criteria.condition: the init agent's report shows ABI below 4 or lacks the workspace among Writable
criteria.action: close the init sandbox without running git
criteria.contract: Sync returns an error wrapping ErrNoLandlock; the slot stays free

criteria.condition: the init command returns outcome exec_failed or exit status 126 or 127, any other non-zero exit, or the context ends or the sandbox's expiry is reached
criteria.action: fail the Sync
criteria.contract: exec_failed/126/127: an error saying git could not be run under the sandbox's ruleset, advising to install git beneath a system directory or add its directory to Options.ExtraRO, with the output tail; other non-zero exit: an error naming the URL with the last 2 KiB of output; done context: an error wrapping ctx.Err(); expiry: an error wrapping sandbox.ErrUnavailable

criteria.condition: a GitRepo Sync fails after the init agent started
criteria.action: once the init agent is gone, remove the workspace's contents with the destroy step's removal while keeping the workspace directory, and leave the sandbox's own agent running
criteria.contract: after the failed Sync the workspace directory exists and is empty, the slot is free, and Tools on the sandbox still succeeds

requirements.title: Reap
requirements.rationale: A crashed embedder leaves a directory and possibly a background process behind; Reap must remove them without ever touching a live sandbox or a reused pid.

criteria.action: list Root's direct entries and consider only directories (never symlinks) whose name is 16 lowercase hex characters and whose marker can be read, leaving every other entry untouched
criteria.contract: files, symlinks, directories with other names and directories with an unreadable or missing marker remain unchanged after Reap

criteria.action: for any marker and process lookup, judge the owner alive exactly when /proc/<pid> exists, the process's start time equals the recorded one and the current boot id equals the recorded one, as a pure function tested on every platform
criteria.contract: owner alive → keep; owner dead → remove; pid reused with a different start time → remove; different boot id → remove

criteria.condition: a sandbox's marker owner is alive
criteria.action: skip the sandbox, whichever process created it
criteria.contract: the sandbox directory and its agent are unchanged and its id is not returned

criteria.condition: a sandbox's marker owner is not alive
criteria.action: SIGKILL every process in the agent's session as the destroy step's action 2 does when the marker names the agent, the boot id matches and no process with the agent's pid exists, and then remove the directory as the destroy step's action 3 does
criteria.contract: the session's processes no longer exist and the sandbox directory is gone; no signal is sent when the boot id differs or the marker names the creator

criteria.action: return the ids it removed, sorted, together with the joined errors of any removals that failed
criteria.contract: returns ([]string sorted ascending, nil) when every removal succeeds, or (removed ids, errors.Join of failures) otherwise

criteria.condition: on Linux ABI 4, the process that created a sandbox (a re-executed test child) is killed after starting a background process through proxy execute
criteria.action: remove that sandbox and kill the background process that outlived the agent
criteria.contract: Reap returns a slice containing the sandbox's id; the background process and the sandbox directory no longer exist; a sandbox with a live agent created by another process is not removed

requirements.title: Unconfined host, build constraints, test target and example
requirements.rationale: The provider must never confine the embedder or add a dependency, and its network test and example must stay out of the offline gate.

criteria.action: import neither github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock nor sandbox/internal/confine, directly or transitively
criteria.contract: `go list -deps ./landlock` in the sandbox module lists neither package, and TS-15-39 passes

criteria.action: gain no Go module dependency from this spec
criteria.contract: the sandbox module's direct requirements in sandbox/go.mod are unchanged

criteria.action: apply no Landlock ruleset, seccomp filter or other restriction to the embedder's own process
criteria.contract: a re-executed test child that runs Create, a LocalDir Sync, Tools, proxy execute and Close over this provider can afterwards create a file outside the workspace and connect to a loopback listener

criteria.condition: the Linux tests run on a kernel with Landlock ABI below 4
criteria.action: skip with a message naming the ABI found, while the offline tests run on every platform within make check without network access
criteria.contract: `go test ./landlock/` exits 0 on such a host and every skipped test's message names the probed ABI

criteria.action: provide a `sandbox-landlock-test` target that runs `go test -count=1 -v ./landlock/` in sandbox/ with AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_GIT_URL defaulting to `https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go`, and keep it out of `make check`
criteria.contract: `make -n sandbox-landlock-test` prints that command with the default URL; `check` does not depend on `sandbox-landlock-test`

criteria.condition: AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_GIT_URL is set on a Linux ABI 4 host
criteria.action: run a real public GitRepo clone under NetworkNone
criteria.contract: the repository's files appear in the workspace and a later TCP connect from proxy execute fails; without the variable the test is skipped

criteria.condition: examples/sandbox is run with --landlock and --agent PATH
criteria.action: run the same program on landlock.New(Options{AgentBinary: PATH}) under NetworkNone, leaving the default offline run and its main_test.go unchanged
criteria.contract: the program exits 0 on a Linux ABI 4 host, and exits non-zero with an error wrapping ErrNoLandlock elsewhere

execution_paths.title: An embedder runs a command in a confined sandbox and closes it

steps.action: calls landlock.New(Options{AgentBinary: <built agentkit-sandboxd>, Root: <temp dir>})
probes the kernel's Landlock ABI with syscall 444, resolves Root and the agent binary, and runs `<binary> --version` to check protocol 1.≥2
calls Create(ctx, sandbox.Spec{}) asking for NetworkNone

runs CheckSpec and its own refusals, creates <Root>/<id>/ with the creator marker, workspace/, home/ and tmp/, and starts agentkit-sandboxd in a new session with --ttl, --network none and --workdir <workspace> and the private environment
applies its Landlock ruleset and answers Hello with its LandlockInfo
checks the report against the ABI 4 floor, rewrites the marker to name the agent and returns the wrapper sandbox
Syncs a LocalDir, calls Tools and runs proxy execute commands that write in the workspace and fail to write the real home or open a TCP connection
calls Close
stops the agent, kills every process in its session and removes <Root>/<id>/

execution_paths.title: An embedder fills a sandbox from a public GitRepo through the init agent

steps.action: creates a NetworkNone sandbox and calls Sync(ctx, sandbox.GitRepo{URL: <https url>})
checks attach.Live, gitclone.Check, the free slot and Agent().Git under the write lock
starts an init agentkit-sandboxd with --network unrestricted, the same workspace and roots plus the resolver directory, and a git-only environment, and checks its Landlock report
runs `git` with gitclone.Args through its run_command tool, writing the repository into the workspace
closes the init sandbox, takes the slot and returns a zero SyncResult
calls Tools and proxy execute, sees the cloned files, and a TCP connect from the sandbox still fails

execution_paths.title: A crashed embedder's sandbox is reaped by a later process

steps.action: creates a sandbox, starts a background process through proxy execute and is killed
sees its stdin close and exits, leaving the sandbox directory and the background process
calls landlock.New with the same Root and then Reap(ctx)
reads the marker, finds the agent owner dead on the same boot, SIGKILLs the agent's session and removes the sandbox directory
returns the removed sandbox's id while leaving sandboxes with live agents untouched

execution_paths.title: A sandbox that is never closed is destroyed at its TTL

steps.action: calls Create with Spec{TTL: 5 * time.Second} and starts a background process through proxy execute without calling Close
fires at the TTL and runs the provider's destroy step
stops the agent, kills its session including the background process, and removes <Root>/<id>/
observes that later calls on the sandbox fail with sandbox.ErrUnavailable

execution_paths.title: A developer runs the sandbox example on the Landlock provider

steps.action: runs `go run ./examples/sandbox --landlock --agent <path to agentkit-sandboxd>`
constructs landlock.New with that agent binary and creates a NetworkNone sandbox
starts the confined agent and returns the sandbox
runs the same program as the default run over the sandbox's proxy tools, closes the sandbox and exits 0
